summary: Iteration 9 full-stack test of Noxeal — admin manual article CRUD, sitemap-index + 4 sub-sitemaps, /api/topics pillar pages, admin delete user/subscriber/comment, ArticleUpdate new fields, header wordmark refactor, /temas + /temas/:slug pillar SEO pages with breadcrumb + FAQ + JSON-LD, /categoria/:slug redirect, article meta robots + hreflang es-ES + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. Backend: 18/18 iter9 pytest pass (100%). Frontend: 100% — /temas shows exactly 5 topic cards with correct article_count (Jeffrey Epstein 1, IA 9, Deepfakes 11, CBDC 4, Salud-redes 22); /temas/jeffrey-epstein has h1 'Jeffrey Epstein', breadcrumb 'Inicio · Temas · Jeffrey Epstein', tema-articles block, 3 FAQs (tema-faq-0/1/2). Header has NOXEAL wordmark + blue dot, ZERO on home. Admin login as noxael18@gmail.com / Noxeal2026! works → /admin. Modal 'Nuevo artículo' opens with 15/15 expected testids (create-title, create-excerpt, create-category, create-status, create-fact-level, create-verification, create-tags, create-author, create-source, create-image, create-meta, create-body, create-save-draft, create-publish, create-cancel). Publish flow: toast '✓ Creado: "TEST UI iter9 articulo manual" (published)' appears + article appears in admin list without manual refresh. Edit modal pre-fills title, fact_level=analysis, verification_level=68. Subscribers tab: 8 delete-subscriber-* buttons. Users tab: 29 delete-user-* buttons; clicking self-delete returns toast 'No puedes eliminar tu propia cuenta' (HTTP 400) ✅. Comments tab: 6 admin-delete-comment-* buttons. Article page /articulo/libro-negro-digital-epstein: meta robots='index,follow,max-image-preview:large,max-snippet:-1', hreflang=['es-ES','x-default'], JSON-LD types=['NewsArticle','NewsMediaOrganization','BreadcrumbList']. /guardados regression OK (h1 'Lista de lectura'). /categoria/tecnologia → 302 redirect to /explorar?cat=tecnologia. POST /api/admin/articles/manual: full body returns doc with fact_level (normalized lowercase 'analysis'), verification_level=75, status, category_slug; body-as-string is coerced to list; unauth=401/403; missing body=422. DELETE /api/admin/users/{self}=400. DELETE /api/admin/newsletter/{email} works (200 then 404). PUT /api/admin/articles/{slug} accepts new fields fact_level, verification_level, status, source_url, author and persists them. Make.com regression: POST /api/articles with tags:null, factLevel:'ANALYSIS', verificationLevel:'75%', publish:'true' returns 200 (Pydantic validators OK). /api/articles/by-slugs regression OK.

minor.issue: fact_level value is normalized to lowercase on storage ('ANALYSIS' → 'analysis'), but the create modal dropdown likely sends uppercase. Inconsistent casing across read/write may cause UI mismatch on edit (the modal shows lowercase). Verify Admin.jsx select options match the stored casing.
Returns 422 (Pydantic) instead of 400 when body is missing — review request expected 400 with clear message. Cosmetic; both signal validation error.

issues: Fecha de actualización label not visible because updated_at == published_at for current articles. Confirmed conditional rendering works; will appear only on edited articles. Not a bug.

action_items: [Low] Align fact_level casing between create-fact-level dropdown options and DB-stored value (currently lowercase). Either store as uppercase or convert dropdown options to lowercase to keep edit modal value matching <option>.

[Low] Decide whether missing-body on admin manual create should return 400 with explicit message (review request asked for 400 with mensaje claro). Currently FastAPI Pydantic returns 422 — works but UX could be better with a custom validator returning HTTPException(400).
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 pillar topics in PILLAR_TOPICS have correct article_count via tag matching; the values (1, 9, 11, 4, 22) line up with current dataset.

Sitemap-index references sub-sitemaps at root domain (e.g., /sitemap-articles.xml), but the working endpoints are at /api/sitemap-articles.xml. Verify that the Kubernetes/static rewrite handles both paths, otherwise Google bots fetching the root-level sub-sitemap URLs from the index will get the SPA HTML. Recommend either: (a) emit /api/sitemap-*.xml URLs in index, or (b) ensure the frontend rewrites these specific paths to the backend.
Edit modal correctly pre-fills fact_level and verification_level — confirmed visually with 'analysis' and 68.
Self-delete guard works at backend (400) AND UI shows error toast — defense in depth ✅.
PILLAR_TOPICS list_topics + get_topic registered with @app.get directly (outside api_router) — works but inconsistent with rest of routes. Same pattern noted in iter5 for POST /api/articles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 15 modal testids, 5 topic cards, 3 FAQs, all delete buttons, edit pre-fill, self-delete guard, JSON-LD + hreflang + meta robots + breadcrumb verified
